text:
Sam (Support): Hey team, Acme reported their invoice shows ~40% fewer embedding units for a week of rerank traffic. They say UI counts match their logs but invoice is low. Can we triage? :thinking_face:
Priya (Billing): @Sam can you paste a request id or example payload? Need to match invoice rows to events.
Sam (Support): They sent this example in the ticket: request_id=req_0a1b2c, endpoint=/v1/rerank, payload below:
```json
{
  \"model\": \"text-embed-1536\",
  \"queries\": 10,
  \"candidates\": 100,
  \"pairwise\": true
}
```
Sam (Support): Their internal metric says they expect billing = queries * candidates * pairwise_factor (roughly 10*100*1 = 1000 units) but invoice rows show ~280 units for the same timeframe.
Jordan (SRE): Hmm. Two quick thoughts: 1) Are we counting pairwise as n*(n-1)/2 or n*candidates? 2) Any batching/padding logic that collapses multiple candidate vectors into a single bill row?
Hannah (Platform): I pulled the metering logs for req_0a1b2c: metering_event: {ts:1863999990, model:text-embed-1536, inputs:110, billed_vectors:28, batch_shape:[8, 48]} (redacted)
Priya (Billing): Billed_vectors:28 vs inputs:110 — that explains the gap. Why would billed_vectors be 28?
Jordan (SRE): Looks like a batch dimension folding bug in the async batcher. For some older routes we dedupe identical candidate vectors before metering to save cost (intended only for embeddings endpoint), and the rerank path was accidentally flagged. Dedupe produced 28 unique vectors from 110 inputs.
Sam (Support): So rerank calls ended up being deduped and charged only once per unique vector. Customer expects per-input charging. Oof.
Priya (Billing): Can we reproduce reliably? Need concrete repro to justify credits and to rollback the change if widespread.
Jordan (SRE): Repro script (local) — curl that mimics pairwise rerank payload. If you run with repeated candidate vector values you'll see dedupe hit. Example minimal repro:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-1536","queries":["q1"],"candidates":["same-candidate","same-candidate","different"]}'
```
Jordan (SRE): In our staging metering logs I toggled dedupe flag and saw billed_vectors go from 2 -> 3 for that payload. So bug confirmed: rerank path inherited dedupe behavior from embedding pipeline during a refactor on 2026-11-02.
Hannah (Platform): Timeline: change rolled to prod 2026-11-02 at 02:12 UTC (deploy id: deploy_20261102_0212). Impact window matches Acme's invoice window.
Priya (Billing): For next steps: 1) Disable dedupe on rerank in prod immediately (low risk rollback). 2) Run billed vs raw-event reconcile for affected accounts. 3) Draft credit proposal.
Sam (Support): I informed Acme and asked for logs + sample invoice rows. They provided invoice_line_id=inv_99aabb, which maps to metering_event row me_8877.
Metering Bot: Auto-detected anomaly: account=acme, delta=-42%, flagged at 2026-11-08T09:10:11Z.
Jordan (SRE): I've pushed a hotfix to flip the flag off: PR #4821 merged. Deploy scheduled in 20m. I also added an integration test in metering to ensure rerank uses per-input accounting.
Hannah (Platform): After hotfix deploy I'll trigger a replay job to re-run metering for the impacted window and generate corrected invoice rows. That will create reconciliation artifacts.
Priya (Billing): Once we have corrected rows, I'll compute proposed credit for Acme. Tentative credit = (expected_units - billed_units) * rate. I'll share numbers before issuing.
Sam (Support): Customer asked for ETA. What should I tell them?
Jordan (SRE): Hotfix deploy + replay should finish ~3 hours. Then billing needs ~1 day to compute credits. Tell them estimated resolution in 48 hours and we'll send interim status updates.
Priya (Billing): Also note: if customer's own logs dedupe on their side (they might be de-duping candidate lists), the expected billing could legitimately be lower. We'll compare their raw payloads to our raw ingestion to be sure.
Sam (Support): Good point. @Acme — can you confirm whether your client dedupes candidates before sending?
Sam (Support): (customer reply pasted) \"We don't dedupe — we always send full candidate lists. We noticed discrepancy started Nov 3\"
Jordan (SRE): Action items: \n- [x] Disable dedupe on rerank (hotfix merged)\n- [ ] Run metering replay for window 2026-11-02 -> 2026-11-09 (Hannah)\n- [ ] Recompute invoice rows and draft credits (Priya)\n- [ ] Postmortem with deploy timeline and rollback notes (Jordan)
Sam (Support): I'll follow up with Acme and set expectations. Thanks everyone :pray:
Priya (Billing): I'll CC finance once we have credit calc.
Hannah (Platform): FYI I added a dashboard panel: \"rerank dedupe hits\" and alerted on >1% rate across accounts.
Jordan (SRE): Preventative: adding unit test for batch-shape propagation and a lint check that flags accidental flag inheritance between pipelines.
Sam (Support): Closing loop here once credits issued. Leaving thread open for updates.
Priya (Billing): Update: replay finished, corrected billed_vectors for Acme = 1020 (was 280). Draft credit computed, sending to finance for approval.
Sam (Support): Customer notified and appreciative. :thumbsup:
